intro.text: A hardy plant of northwestern Alethkar, around Hearthstone, that grows in dense thickets around big markel trees, which together give it some shelter from highstorms.

description.text: Snarlbrush is tan or brown, as if dead, but turns bright green wherever water touches it, then slowly fades back to brown as the water soaks in. Kaladin remembers Lirin telling him about this.
